comparison: Baseline characterization only. No optimization or paired performance change claim; candidate production source is required to remain byte-identical.
method: Each operation: one untimed warmup; five wall-clock trials with GC before each; separate sixth traced-allocation operation. Hash/output checks happen after timed intervals. Fixture preparation excluded. Shared interpreter OS lifetime high-water RSS includes earlier workloads and tracing, not per-workload RSS. File cache/scheduler uncontrolled. Five startup/first-run subprocess trials likewise follow an untimed warmup; parent traced allocation does not measure child memory.
